title: The Itch
summary: Nasruddin was seen scratching his left arm furiously with both hands....
full_text:
Nasruddin was seen scratching his left arm furiously with both hands.

"Mulla," asked his friend, "why do you scratch your left arm with such violence?"

"Because," replied Nasruddin, "my right foot has an unbearable itch, but my arm is so much closer to my hands!"
moral: Treating the symptom while ignoring the cause brings endless agitation.
